name: integer_topn
sql: SELECT id, amount FROM {table} ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: mixed_direction_and_null_order
sql: SELECT id, grp, amount FROM {table} ORDER BY grp ASC NULLS FIRST, amount ASC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 13

name: bigint_boundaries
sql: SELECT id, big_key FROM {table} ORDER BY big_key DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 9

name: hidden_timestamp_order_key
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY created_at DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 11

name: date_null_and_ad_boundaries
sql: SELECT id, created_date FROM {table} ORDER BY created_date ASC NULLS FIRST, id DESC LIMIT 13

name: timestamp_cutover_and_microseconds
sql: SELECT id, created_at FROM {table} WHERE created_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 12

name: sum_having_topn
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM {table} GROUP BY grp HAVING SUM(amount) >= 0 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

name: hidden_count_having_order_key
sql: SELECT grp FROM {table} GROUP BY grp HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC NULLS FIRST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4

name: group_min_max
sql: SELECT grp, MIN(amount) AS lo, MAX(amount) AS hi FROM {table} GROUP BY grp ORDER BY hi DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4

name: count_distinct_having
sql: SELECT grp, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS n FROM {table} GROUP BY grp HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) > 1 ORDER BY n DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 5

name: distinct_topn
sql: SELECT DISTINCT grp FROM {table} ORDER BY grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4

name: scalar_empty_input
sql: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(amount), MIN(amount), MAX(amount) FROM {table} WHERE id < 0

name: group_empty_input
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM {table} WHERE id < 0 GROUP BY grp ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4

name: all_null_aggregate_group
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(amount) AS n FROM {table} WHERE grp = 2 GROUP BY grp ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

name: scalar_avg_exact
sql: SELECT AVG(id), COUNT(amount), SUM(amount) FROM {table}

name: multiple_count_distinct
sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), COUNT(DISTINCT grp) FROM {table}

name: residual_filter_fallback
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} WHERE MD5(name) = MD5('name_1') ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: residual_having_fallback
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM {table} GROUP BY grp HAVING ABS(SUM(amount)) > 1 ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

name: text_c_collation_key_topn
sql: SELECT id, name FROM {table} ORDER BY name ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: float_order_fallback
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY ratio ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: bounded_numeric_hidden_key_topn
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY price DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: timestamptz_order_fallback
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY created_z ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: offset_fallback
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY amount DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 5 OFFSET 2

name: aggregate_offset_fallback
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM {table} GROUP BY grp ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3 OFFSET 1

name: derived_timestamp_order_fallback
sql: SELECT grp, MAX(created_at) AS latest FROM {table} GROUP BY grp ORDER BY latest DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

name: integer_project_topn
sql: SELECT id, amount + 1 AS shifted FROM {table} ORDER BY shifted DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: aggregate_above_limited_input
sql: SELECT grp, SUM(amount) AS total FROM (SELECT grp, amount FROM {table} ORDER BY id ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 12) s GROUP BY grp ORDER BY total DESC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 3

name: text_default_collation_topn
sql: SELECT id, label FROM {table} ORDER BY label ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 15
pg_sql: SELECT id, label FROM {table} ORDER BY label COLLATE "C" ASC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 15

name: text_c_collation_topn
sql: SELECT id, name FROM {table} ORDER BY name DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 11

name: varchar_hidden_order_key
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY label DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 9
pg_sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY label COLLATE "C" DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC LIMIT 9

name: boolean_topn
sql: SELECT id FROM {table} ORDER BY active DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 13

name: bounded_numeric_topn
sql: SELECT id, price FROM {table} ORDER BY price DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 10

name: unbounded_numeric_order_fallback
sql: SELECT id, unbounded_amount FROM {table} ORDER BY unbounded_amount ASC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 14

name: mixed_text_and_numeric_keys
sql: SELECT id, label, price FROM {table} ORDER BY label ASC NULLS LAST, price DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 12
pg_sql: SELECT id, label, price FROM {table} ORDER BY label COLLATE "C" ASC NULLS LAST, price DESC NULLS FIRST, id ASC LIMIT 12

name: double_order_fallback
sql: SELECT id, ratio FROM {table} ORDER BY ratio DESC NULLS LAST, id ASC LIMIT 7

name: text_min_aggregate_order_fallback
sql: SELECT grp, MIN(label) AS first_label FROM {table} GROUP BY grp ORDER BY first_label ASC NULLS LAST, grp ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 4
